context_requirements: Cells must have intact ATM-dependent DNA damage response signaling for the inhibitor to produce a detectable transcriptional effect.
Cells must have basal or induced DNA damage/replication stress for ATM inhibition to alter transcription; otherwise response is minimal.
TP53 status influences downstream transcriptional output; TP53-mutant lines may show weaker p53-dependent gene induction.
Proliferating cells with active cell cycle checkpoints are more likely to show transcriptional changes.
falsifiers: No change in CDKN1A, GADD45A, or other p53/DNA damage response genes at 6 h or 24 h in any cell line.
No decrease in cell cycle genes such as CCNA2, CCNB1, or CDK1 at 24 h.
Strong and consistent upregulation of proliferation genes across all lines, which would contradict ATM inhibition.
Lack of any transcriptional response in cell lines known to have functional ATM and TP53.

evidence.supports: ATM inhibitor KU-60019 radiosensitizes glioma cells and affects AKT/ERK signaling, indicating ATM inhibition can modulate signaling pathways.
ATM inhibitor KU-55933 affects replication and induces G1-phase arrest in Toxoplasma, showing cell cycle effects of ATM inhibition.
AZD0156, an ATM inhibitor, shows anti-proliferative effects in colorectal cancer cell lines, supporting potential growth inhibition.
ATM inhibitor increases sensitivity of breast cancer cells to etoposide, indicating role in DNA damage response.

changes: Removed PRKDC from primary_targets because the cited abstracts describe ATM-specific inhibitors and do not support DNA-PK as a primary target.
Removed FAS from late_up because the cited abstracts do not support ATM inhibition directly inducing FAS transcription.
Removed TNFRSF21 from late_up because the cited abstracts do not support ATM inhibition directly inducing TNFRSF21 transcription.
Removed SQSTM1 from late_up because the cited abstracts do not support ATM inhibition directly inducing SQSTM1 transcription.
Removed BAX from late_up because the cited abstracts do not support ATM inhibition directly inducing BAX transcription.
Removed PMAIP1 from late_up because the cited abstracts do not support ATM inhibition directly inducing PMAIP1 transcription.
